BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Takko, Hobbs, Palumbo, Saldaña, Hunt, Conway, Chase, and Mullet
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Authorizing the issuance of personalized collector vehicle license plates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to personalized collector vehicle license plates; and amending RCW 46.17.210.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 46.17.210 and 2013 c 329 s 6 are each amended to read as follows:Personalized license plate fees.
BillSection.P: (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, in addition to all fees and taxes required to be paid upon application for a vehicle registration under chapter 46.16A RCW, the holder of a personalized license plate shall pay an initial fee of fifty-two dollars and forty-two dollars for each renewal.

P.TextRun: (2) In addition to all fees and taxes required to be paid upon application for a vehicle registration under chapter 46.16A RCW and RCW 46.17.220(1)(f), a registered owner with a collector vehicle license plate issued under RCW 46.18.220 may receive a personalized collector vehicle license plate upon payment of a one-time initial fee of fifty-two dollars.

BillSection.P: (3) The personalized license plate fees under this section must be distributed as provided in RCW 46.68.435.

AnnNote.NoteP: Application—2013 c 329 § 6: "Section 6 of this act applies only to vehicle registrations that are due or become due on or after October 1, 2013." [2013 c 329 § 7.]
